title: Selling Plans Cancellation Record Window by Seller Tenure
content:
The seller cancellation defects that count toward a cancellation administration fee on **Selling Plans** are those within the cancellation record window, whose length depends on how long ago the seller's selling plan was verified.

**Rule.** The cancellation record window of a cancellation administration fee is the long record window when the selling plan was verified at least the long record tenure months before the decision date, the mid record window when it was verified at least the mid record tenure months but fewer than the long record tenure months before, and the standard record window otherwise, the tenure being counted in whole months; a window of that many whole months takes the seller cancellation defects dated less than that many whole months before the decision date.

| Whole months from the plan's verification date to the decision date | Cancellation record window |
|---|---|
| 24 or more (the long record tenure months) | 12 whole months (long record window) |
| 12 or more but fewer than 24 (the mid record tenure months up to the long) | 9 whole months (mid record window) |
| Fewer than 12 | 6 whole months (standard record window) |

## Hypothetical cases (plan verified on 20 January 2024)

- Decided on 20 January 2026: 24 whole months → 12-month window.
- Decided on 19 January 2026: 23 whole months → 9-month window.
- Decided on 19 January 2025: 11 whole months → 6-month window.

**Which defects fall inside (hypothetical, 6-month window, decision on 20 July).** A seller cancellation defect dated 21 January is less than 6 whole months before 20 July and counts; one dated 20 January is a full 6 whole months before and does not.
